name: SynapDome Browser Traffic Legacy Plugin
sourceConcept: CyberStrikeAI browser extension traffic capture pattern
purpose: Capture authorized browser DevTools traffic as HAR/API evidence, upload it to SynapDome, and allow the SynapDome agentic prompt to queue web/API scans against approved URLs.
securityRequirements: Require explicit engagement selection before capture starts.
Show the hostname being captured to the user.
Redact credentials by default before upload.
Pass only signed artifact URLs or normalized target URLs to the Red Team Agent Node.
